heroSummary: Tempe Union High School District students begin the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, July 22, 2026. The TUHSD high school calendar includes semester exam windows in December and May, district inservice half days, and major breaks in fall, winter, and spring. The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, with graduation listed for Thursday, May 27.
calendarNotes: The TUHSD 2026–27 calendar lists 180 student days, 188 days for teachers, and 190 days for new teachers. The calendar was approved by the Governing Board on April 2, 2025. TUHSD serves grades 9–12, so families with younger children should compare this calendar with the separate elementary or middle school district calendar that applies to those students. Semester exam windows are December 16–17, 2026, and May 25–26, 2027. District inservice dates on August 26 and February 10 are marked as half days for students. Graduation is listed one day after the final student day; seniors and their families should check their school for the ceremony time and location.

calendarFaqs.q: Are TUHSD inservice days full days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The reviewed 2026–27 calendar marks August 26, 2026, and February 10, 2027, as district inservice half days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all TUHSD schools use the same semester exam schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar lists exam windows for December 16–17, 2026, and May 25–26, 2027. Bell schedules, dismissal times, and campus testing details may vary, so families should confirm the daily schedule with their student’s school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the graduation date include the ceremony time and location?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district calendar lists graduation on Thursday, May 27, 2027, but ceremony times and locations may be published by each high school.

calendarFaqs.q: Do TUHSD breaks match local elementary district calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Not necessarily. TUHSD serves grades 9–12, so families with younger children should compare these dates with the elementary or middle school district calendar assigned to those students.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later TUHSD revisions.

customSections.label: What Families Should Know About the TUHSD Calendar
customSections.content:
TUHSD starts the school year on July 22 and schedules two-week fall and spring breaks. The calendar also includes two district inservice half days and exam windows at the end of both semesters.

Because TUHSD serves grades 9–12, families with younger children may need to compare these dates with the calendar for the elementary or middle school district that serves them.

The district calendar does not include campus bell schedules, exam dismissal times, or graduation ceremony details. Check your student’s school before arranging transportation or time off.
